title: The decisions screen shows where a derived answer was read from, each decision's category, and filters by them
name: decisions-derived
description: apps/dashboard/src/decisions/Decisions.tsx already lists every decision with the chosen option, the options not picked and the bound nodes. A derived answer is only a faint 'derived' word whose source is in a hover `title`, and the category is not shown. Show the source inline ('read off: <path>'), show the category, and add a filter: all / open / answered / derived. Tests in data.test.ts for the filter.
